execution_steps.source_title: ## 13.1 阶段一：接收业务意图
execution_steps.summary_en: Capture intent and immutable origin, create trace/run/intent identities, record actor and delegation, distinguish advice from effects.
execution_steps.summary_zh: 接收并冻结原始意图引用，创建链路、运行与意图标识，记录主体委托，区分建议查询与外部动作。

execution_steps.source_title: ## 13.2 阶段二：规范化动作
execution_steps.summary_en: Normalize action type, tool/version/environment, defaults and implicit scope; calculate quantity/value and flag policy or privilege changes.
execution_steps.summary_zh: 规范动作类型、工具版本环境，展开默认值和隐式范围，计算数量金额，识别策略变更及权限扩大。

execution_steps.source_title: ## 13.3 阶段三：确认对象与版本
execution_steps.summary_en: Resolve stable object IDs, versions and digests; freeze batch manifests and query/result snapshots; reject ambiguous names and ineligible targets.
execution_steps.summary_zh: 解析稳定对象标识、版本和摘要，冻结批量清单及查询结果快照，拒绝模糊名称并检查对象可操作性。

execution_steps.source_title: ## 13.4 阶段四：收集证据
execution_steps.summary_en: Load required evidence, independently verify high-risk changes, record sources/versions/times/expiry, and retain missing/conflicting/untrusted items.
execution_steps.summary_zh: 加载必需证据，对高风险变化独立核验，记录来源版本时间及有效期，保留缺失冲突和低可信证据。

execution_steps.source_title: ## 13.5 阶段五：计算差异和影响
execution_steps.summary_en: Compare the baseline, highlight additions/removals/replacements/scope expansion, and calculate impact, external visibility and reversal cost.
execution_steps.summary_zh: 与基线比较新增删除替换及扩围，计算金额数量、外部可见性、潜在影响和撤销补偿成本，突出关键差异。

execution_steps.source_title: ## 13.6 阶段六：检查可审条件
execution_steps.summary_en: Require clear targets, complete evidence, visible impact/differences/reversibility and determinable policy; otherwise supplement, clarify, resolve policy or stop.
execution_steps.summary_zh: 要求对象明确、证据完整、影响差异可逆性可见、策略可确定；否则补证、澄清、处置策略冲突或停止。

execution_steps.source_title: ## 13.7 阶段七：策略匹配与风险路由
execution_steps.summary_en: Snapshot current policy, apply denies first, determine automatic authority or roles/counts/hierarchy, separation, expiry, usage and rechecks; explain the route.
execution_steps.summary_zh: 冻结当前策略，先匹配拒绝规则，再确定自动权限或角色人数层级、职责分离、有效期次数和重检项，解释路由原因。

execution_steps.source_title: ## 13.8 阶段八：生成审批卡
execution_steps.summary_en: For human review bind the card/request to proposal and policy digests; show differences, evidence, consequences and exact scope with minimal sensitive data.
execution_steps.summary_zh: 人审时将审批卡请求绑定提案及策略摘要，展示差异证据影响和精确范围，最小化敏感披露。

execution_steps.source_title: ## 13.9 阶段九：分配审批者
execution_steps.summary_en: Select by current role and authority; verify conflicts, separation and substitution/delegation, document assignments and set timeout/escalation.
execution_steps.summary_zh: 按当前角色权限分配，核验利益冲突、职责分离及代班委托，记录分配理由并设置超时升级路线。

execution_steps.source_title: ## 13.10 阶段十：持久化等待状态
execution_steps.summary_en: Durably save run, proposal/policy digests, request/decisions/missing roles, expiry, resume point, preconditions, state version and replay keys before waiting.
execution_steps.summary_zh: 等待前持久化运行、提案策略摘要、请求决定及缺失角色、期限、恢复点、业务前提、状态版本及重放幂等信息。

execution_steps.source_title: ## 13.11 阶段十一：接收审批决定
execution_steps.summary_en: Authenticate each callback and current role, request binding, expiry/revocation and separation; deduplicate decisions; record allow/deny/conditions/evidence return.
execution_steps.summary_zh: 认证回调身份与当前角色，核验请求绑定、期限撤权及职责分离，幂等记录允许拒绝附条件或补证决定。

execution_steps.source_title: ## 13.12 阶段十二：计算会签结果
execution_steps.summary_en: Count valid distinct identities and required roles, enforce all counts, veto/withdrawal and compatible conditions; wait, allow, deny, invalidate, escalate or re-propose.
execution_steps.summary_zh: 统计有效不同身份及所需角色人数，检查拒绝撤回与条件相容，决定继续等待、允许、拒绝、失效、升级或重建提案。

execution_steps.source_title: ## 13.13 阶段十三：签发治理回执
execution_steps.summary_en: Issue only a policy-compliant trusted signed receipt binding decision, proposal/policy, decision references, scope, expiry, usage and conditions.
execution_steps.summary_zh: 仅在策略满足时签发可信签名回执，绑定最终决定、提案策略、决定引用、范围、期限、次数及条件。

execution_steps.source_title: ## 13.14 阶段十四：恢复运行
execution_steps.summary_en: Load the latest trusted checkpoint, bind the resume request to the run, fetch current proposal/policy/business facts and enter revalidation rather than tool execution.
execution_steps.summary_zh: 加载最新可信检查点，核验恢复请求和运行，重读当前提案策略与业务事实，从重新验证恢复而非直接调用工具。

execution_steps.source_title: ## 13.15 阶段十五：执行前重新验证
execution_steps.summary_en: Recheck trusted allow receipt, exact proposal/policy bindings, expiry/usage, current quorum, business conditions, object/environment/scope and idempotency; refuse on failure.
execution_steps.summary_zh: 重检可信允许回执、提案策略精确绑定、期限次数、当前会签、业务前提、对象环境范围及幂等状态；失败不得执行。

execution_steps.source_title: ## 13.16 阶段十六：原子消费许可
execution_steps.summary_en: Atomically compare receipt/state versions, verify availability, consume usage, reserve idempotency and persist an execution attempt; concurrent losers do not dispatch.
execution_steps.summary_zh: 原子比较回执与状态版本、确认可用、消费次数、预留幂等键并持久化执行尝试；并发失败方不能再次派发。

execution_steps.source_title: ## 13.17 阶段十七：执行受控动作
execution_steps.summary_en: Execute only approved tool/version, environment, parameters, objects, amount/count, identity and time window; never append targets at runtime.
execution_steps.summary_zh: 只执行已批工具版本、环境、参数、对象、金额数量、身份及窗口，不得临时追加对象或扩大范围。

execution_steps.source_title: ## 13.18 阶段十八：核对实际效果
execution_steps.summary_en: Query destination effects, compare requested/actual digests and scope, record partial/duplicate/excess/missing results and external IDs; success requires reconciliation.
execution_steps.summary_zh: 查询目的端效果，比较请求与实际摘要范围，记录部分成功、重复、超额、遗漏及外部引用；核对一致才标记成功。

execution_steps.source_title: ## 13.19 阶段十九：失败与补偿
execution_steps.summary_en: Reconcile uncertain outcomes before retry, retry only unperformed effects within authority, govern compensation and escalate unresolved incidents.
execution_steps.summary_zh: 不确定结果先对账再重试，仅在有效权限内重试未发生效果；补偿另行受治理，未决事故升级处置。

execution_steps.source_title: ## 13.20 阶段二十：归档与学习
execution_steps.summary_en: Archive all intent/proposal/evidence/policy/approval/receipt/checkpoint/attempt/effect/compensation/supplement versions, final state and reason; policy learning is separately governed.
execution_steps.summary_zh: 归档意图、提案、证据、策略、决定回执、检查点、尝试效果补偿与补全版本及最终原因；策略学习另走治理流程。

probe_checks.summary_en: Correlate trace/run/proposal/request/receipt/execution/effect identities and causality; detect orphans, duplicates and cross-run associations.
probe_checks.summary_zh: 关联链路运行提案请求回执执行效果与因果，发现孤立对象、重复标识和跨运行误关联。

probe_checks.summary_en: Check actor/action/tool/version/environment, versioned targets, quantity/value, differences, evidence, preconditions, impact, reversibility and proposal digest.
probe_checks.summary_zh: 检查主体动作工具版本环境、对象版本、数量金额、差异证据、业务前提、影响可逆性及提案摘要。

probe_checks.summary_en: Require stable targets, deterministic batch manifests and query plus result snapshots; detect ambiguous names or missing versions.
probe_checks.summary_zh: 要求稳定对象、确定批量清单、查询与结果快照，发现名称歧义及缺失版本。

probe_checks.summary_en: Check that the card highlights account/amount/target/artifact/permission/recipient/data/policy changes, measuring high-risk omissions.
probe_checks.summary_zh: 检查审批卡突出账户金额对象工件权限收件人数据及策略变化，度量高风险差异遗漏。

probe_checks.summary_en: Check required evidence, trusted sources, expiry, target-version binding, conflicts, verifier and independent checks for high-risk changes.
probe_checks.summary_zh: 核验必要证据、可信来源、期限、对象版本绑定、冲突、核验者及高风险独立核验。

probe_checks.summary_en: Check clear targets, complete evidence, visible impact/differences/reversibility and determined policy before human review.
probe_checks.summary_zh: 进入人审前检查对象明确、证据完整、影响差异可逆性可见及策略确定。

probe_checks.summary_en: Verify contemporaneous policy/version/digest, rule precedence, role/count/expiry/use limits and explicit conflict handling.
probe_checks.summary_zh: 验证当时适用策略版本摘要、拒绝优先、角色人数期限次数及显式冲突处理。

probe_checks.summary_en: Independently compare risk/policy inputs and observed routes; detect wrongful automation, human review of prohibited or incomplete proposals and needless escalation.
probe_checks.summary_zh: 独立比较风险策略输入与实际路由，发现错放行、禁止或缺证提案进入人审及不必要升级。

probe_checks.summary_en: Check card summary, target/scope, material changes, verified evidence, impact/reversal, limits, roles, validity/usage and conditions.
probe_checks.summary_zh: 核验审批卡摘要、对象范围、关键变化、证据、影响可逆性、限制角色、期限次数及条件。

probe_checks.summary_en: Verify identity, current role/authority, substitution/delegation, authorization tier and conflicts; detect decisions after suspension or revocation.
probe_checks.summary_zh: 核验身份、当前角色权限、代班委托、层级及利益冲突，发现停职或撤权后审批。

probe_checks.summary_en: Detect prohibited proposer/executor self-approval, policy-beneficiary conflicts, reused identities across roles and non-independent review.
probe_checks.summary_zh: 检查禁止的发起者执行者自批、策略受益冲突、多角色复用身份及不独立复核。

probe_checks.summary_en: Check every role and count, still-valid decisions, vetoes, compatible conditions and duplicate-decision counting.
probe_checks.summary_zh: 检查全部角色人数、决定有效性、否决、条件相容及重复决定计数。

probe_checks.summary_en: Verify decisions remain limited to the specific action, objects, environment, tool/version, validity and usage; detect expanded vague session consent.
probe_checks.summary_zh: 核验决定仅适用于当前动作对象环境工具版本期限次数，发现含糊会话许可被扩大。

probe_checks.summary_en: Check receipt proposal/policy digests, decision set, scope, expiry/use limit and authentic signature or source; missing bindings are high-risk gaps.
probe_checks.summary_zh: 检查回执提案策略摘要、决定集合、范围、期限次数及真实签名来源；缺少绑定形成高风险缺口。

probe_checks.summary_en: Verify durable run state, proposal/policy digests, decisions/missing roles, expiry, resume node, preconditions and state version during waiting.
probe_checks.summary_zh: 核验等待期间持久运行状态、提案策略摘要、决定和缺失角色、期限恢复点、前提及状态版本。

probe_checks.summary_en: Verify trusted checkpoint, current proposal/policy, revalidation entry, run/state version and protection against replaying pre-interruption effects.
probe_checks.summary_zh: 核验可信检查点、当前提案策略、重检入口、运行状态版本及中断前动作的防重复措施。

probe_checks.summary_en: Compare approved versus current objects/count/value/parameters/tool/environment/versions/reversibility/visibility; report each semantic change.
probe_checks.summary_zh: 比较批准与当前对象数量金额参数工具环境版本可逆性可见性，报告全部语义变化。

probe_checks.summary_en: Compare approved/current policy digests, effective time, revocation and emergency rules; identify use of obsolete authorization.
probe_checks.summary_zh: 比较批准与当前策略摘要、生效时间、撤销及紧急规则，发现旧授权继续使用。

probe_checks.source_title: ## 11.19 有效期和使用次数探针
probe_checks.summary_en: Check request/decision/receipt expiry, usage, atomic single-use consumption and revocation; distinguish blocked attempts from repeated effects.
probe_checks.summary_zh: 检查请求决定回执时效、使用次数、原子单次消费及撤销，区分被阻断尝试与已重复效果。

probe_checks.source_title: ## 11.20 业务前置条件新鲜度探针
probe_checks.summary_en: Verify fresh balance/inventory/person/account/contract/artifact/ticket/query/window conditions on resume and detect changes during waiting.
probe_checks.summary_zh: 恢复时核验余额库存人员账户合同工件工单查询结果及执行窗口新鲜度，发现等待期间变化。

probe_checks.summary_en: Check proposal-bound durable idempotency, external-status lookup before retry, per-object partial recovery and callback replay protection.
probe_checks.summary_zh: 核验绑定提案的持久幂等键、重试前外部查询、部分成功逐对象恢复及回调重放保护。

probe_checks.summary_en: Compare requested effect, approved scope and actual effect; detect overrun, omissions, wrong objects, duplicates, partial success and local/destination disagreement.
probe_checks.summary_zh: 比较请求效果、批准范围和实际效果，发现超额遗漏错对象重复部分成功及本地目的端不一致。

probe_checks.summary_en: Investigate no-receipt execution, direct-tool paths, forged approval text, composed low-risk effects, self-relaxed policy, cross-environment or cross-run reuse.
probe_checks.summary_zh: 调查无回执执行、直调工具、伪造已批文本、低风险组合产生高风险效果、自改策略、跨环境或跨运行复用。

probe_checks.summary_en: Check failure compensation/escalation, compensation scope versus actual effects, its own governance, eventual closure and explicit residual obligations.
probe_checks.summary_zh: 检查失败补偿升级、补偿范围与实际效果、补偿自身治理、最终关闭及明确未决责任。

probe_checks.summary_en: Check separately proposed rule changes, old/new diff, expanded automatic exposure, historical simulation, independent approval, rollback and observation period.
probe_checks.summary_zh: 检查规则变更独立提案、前后差异、扩大的自动权限、历史模拟、独立批准、回滚与观察期。

probe_checks.summary_en: Observe reviewer volume, decision speed/streaks, repeated cards, zero returns/rejections, access interactions and unusual time patterns; fatigue is advisory only.
probe_checks.summary_zh: 观察审批负荷、速度及连续同意、重复卡片、零退回拒绝、访问交互及异常时段；疲劳仅为诊断提示。

probe_checks.summary_en: Assess automatic rules for stability, failures, compensation cost, bypass, calculable scope, quality and current policy; propose independently reviewed improvements.
probe_checks.summary_zh: 评估自动规则稳定性、失败补偿成本、绕过、范围可计算性、数据质量及当前策略，提出需独立复核的改进建议。

probe_checks.summary_en: Minimize sensitive card/event/probe data, verify classification/access/retention and ensure supplementary queries never widen authorized access.
probe_checks.summary_zh: 最小化审批卡事件探针敏感数据，验证分级访问留存，确保补全查询不扩大授权访问范围。

metrics.formula_zh: 自动放行提案数 ÷ 可路由提案总数
metrics.formula_en: Automatically allowed proposals / all routable proposals

metrics.formula_zh: 进入人审提案数 ÷ 可路由提案总数
metrics.formula_en: Proposals entering human review / all routable proposals

metrics.formula_zh: 返回补证提案数 ÷ 可路由提案总数
metrics.formula_en: Proposals returned for evidence / all routable proposals

metrics.formula_zh: 硬拒绝提案数 ÷ 可路由提案总数
metrics.formula_en: Hard-denied proposals / all routable proposals

metrics.formula_zh: 升级提案数 ÷ 可路由提案总数
metrics.formula_en: Escalated proposals / all routable proposals

metrics.formula_zh: 实际路线与策略计算不一致数 ÷ 可路由提案总数
metrics.formula_en: Routes inconsistent with independently evaluated policy / all routable proposals

metrics.formula_zh: 第一位审批者决定时间减请求创建时间
metrics.formula_en: First valid approver decision time minus request creation time (seconds)

metrics.formula_zh: 满足全部角色时间减请求创建时间
metrics.formula_en: Time when all required roles are satisfied minus request creation time (seconds)

metrics.formula_zh: 全部人工审批等待时间的中位数
metrics.formula_en: Median human-request waiting duration; disclose observed and censored populations

metrics.formula_zh: 全部人工审批等待时间的高分位值
metrics.formula_en: Configured high quantile of human-request waiting duration; disclose quantile and method

metrics.formula_zh: 过期审批请求数 ÷ 人工审批请求总数
metrics.formula_en: Expired approval requests / all human approval requests

metrics.formula_zh: 升级后完成的请求数 ÷ 升级请求总数
metrics.formula_en: Completed escalated requests / all escalated requests

metrics.formula_zh: 单个审批请求平均补充材料次数
metrics.formula_en: Total material-supplement rounds / approval requests in the cohort

metrics.formula_zh: 请求补充或退回提案数 ÷ 人工审批请求总数
metrics.formula_en: Human requests asking for more material or returning the proposal / all human approval requests

metrics.formula_zh: 审批拒绝数 ÷ 人工审批请求总数
metrics.formula_en: Rejected human approval requests / all human approval requests

metrics.formula_zh: 附条件允许数 ÷ 允许决定总数
metrics.formula_en: Conditionally allowed decisions / all allowed decisions

metrics.formula_zh: 身份、角色或时效无效决定数 ÷ 决定总数
metrics.formula_en: Decisions invalid for identity, role or time / all decisions

metrics.formula_zh: 被职责分离阻止的自批数 ÷ 自批尝试总数
metrics.formula_en: Self-approval attempts blocked by separation / all self-approval attempts

metrics.formula_zh: 未满足角色或人数而被阻止的执行数 ÷ 不完整会签尝试数
metrics.formula_en: Execution attempts blocked for missing roles or counts / all incomplete-quorum attempts

metrics.formula_zh: 完整审批卡数 ÷ 审批卡总数
metrics.formula_en: Complete approval cards / all approval cards

metrics.formula_zh: 已展示高风险变化数 ÷ 应展示高风险变化数
metrics.formula_en: Displayed high-risk changes / all required high-risk changes

metrics.formula_zh: 绑定提案摘要的回执数 ÷ 回执总数
metrics.formula_en: Receipts binding a proposal digest / all receipts

metrics.formula_zh: 绑定策略摘要的回执数 ÷ 回执总数
metrics.formula_en: Receipts binding a policy digest / all receipts

metrics.formula_zh: 未使用即过期回执数 ÷ 回执总数
metrics.formula_en: Receipts expiring unused / all receipts

metrics.formula_zh: 被拦截重复消费数 ÷ 重复消费尝试数
metrics.formula_en: Blocked duplicate-consumption attempts / all duplicate-consumption attempts

metrics.formula_zh: 因提案变化失效回执数 ÷ 待执行回执总数
metrics.formula_en: Receipts invalidated by proposal changes / pending-execution receipts at cohort entry

metrics.formula_zh: 因策略变化失效回执数 ÷ 待执行回执总数
metrics.formula_en: Receipts invalidated by policy changes / pending-execution receipts at cohort entry

metrics.formula_zh: 恢复时发现业务条件变化数 ÷ 恢复次数
metrics.formula_en: Resumes discovering changed business conditions / all resumes

metrics.formula_zh: 完成重检的高风险执行数 ÷ 高风险执行总数
metrics.formula_en: High-risk executions with completed revalidation / all high-risk executions

metrics.formula_zh: 具备有效回执的受控执行数 ÷ 受控执行总数
metrics.formula_en: Controlled executions with verified valid receipts / all controlled executions

metrics.formula_zh: 具备幂等键的外部写操作数 ÷ 外部写操作总数
metrics.formula_en: External writes with a bound idempotency key / all external writes

metrics.formula_zh: 实际效果与批准范围一致数 ÷ 完成执行总数
metrics.formula_en: Completed executions whose actual effects match approved scope / all completed executions

metrics.formula_zh: 部分成功执行数 ÷ 执行总数
metrics.formula_en: Partially successful executions / all executions

metrics.formula_zh: 成功补偿数 ÷ 需要补偿数
metrics.formula_en: Successful compensations / all required compensations

metrics.formula_zh: 无有效审批执行数 ÷ 受控执行总数
metrics.formula_en: Executions proven to lack valid approval / all controlled executions

metrics.formula_zh: 出现批准范围外效果的执行数 ÷ 执行总数
metrics.formula_en: Executions with effects outside approved scope / all executions

metrics.formula_zh: 已收到必需事件数 ÷ 应收到必需事件数
metrics.formula_en: Received applicable required event slots / all expected required event slots

metrics.formula_zh: 可完整关联链路数 ÷ 运行总数
metrics.formula_en: Completely correlated chains / all runs

metrics.formula_zh: 来源可验证数据项数 ÷ 关键数据项总数
metrics.formula_en: Key data items with verifiable sources / all key data items

metrics.formula_zh: 时效合格数据项数 ÷ 有时效要求数据项总数
metrics.formula_en: Freshness-compliant items / all freshness-constrained items

metrics.formula_zh: 可完整重放链路数 ÷ 运行总数
metrics.formula_en: Fully replayable chains / all runs

metrics.formula_zh: 存在冲突的数据项数 ÷ 关键数据项总数
metrics.formula_en: Conflicting key data items / all key data items

metrics.formula_zh: 被采纳补全字段数 ÷ 提交补全字段数
metrics.formula_en: Accepted supplement fields / all submitted supplement fields

metrics.formula_zh: 被拒绝补全字段数 ÷ 提交补全字段数
metrics.formula_en: Rejected supplement fields / all submitted supplement fields

metrics.formula_zh: 单个审批者一小时内完成的决定数
metrics.formula_en: Decisions completed by one authenticated approver per hour

metrics.formula_zh: 低于配置阅读时间的允许决定数 ÷ 允许决定总数
metrics.formula_en: Allowed decisions below configured reading time / all allowed decisions

metrics.formula_zh: 单个审批者连续允许决定的最大数量
metrics.formula_en: Maximum consecutive allowed decisions per authenticated approver

metrics.formula_zh: 高相似度审批卡数 ÷ 审批卡总数
metrics.formula_en: Highly similar approval cards / all approval cards

metrics.formula_zh: 在观察期内无拒绝且样本足够的规则数
metrics.formula_en: Rules with zero rejections in the observation window and sufficient samples

metrics.formula_zh: 高风险且决策时长过短的允许数 ÷ 高风险允许数
metrics.formula_en: High-risk allowed decisions below configured decision time / all high-risk allowed decisions

execution_cases.source_title: 同一提案在满足策略时能够正确自动放行或进入人审；
execution_cases.summary_en: Route the same complete proposal correctly under the applicable automatic or human policy.
execution_cases.summary_zh: 同一提案在满足策略时能够正确自动放行或进入人审；

execution_cases.source_title: 多人会签未满足前不能签发允许回执；
execution_cases.summary_en: Never issue an allow receipt before required quorum is met.
execution_cases.summary_zh: 多人会签未满足前不能签发允许回执；

execution_cases.source_title: 无权限审批者的决定不计入通过；
execution_cases.summary_en: Do not count an unauthorized approver toward approval.
execution_cases.summary_zh: 无权限审批者的决定不计入通过；

execution_cases.source_title: 提案任一语义字段变化后旧回执失效；
execution_cases.summary_en: Invalidate old authorization after any semantic proposal change.
execution_cases.summary_zh: 提案任一语义字段变化后旧回执失效；

execution_cases.source_title: 策略版本变化后旧回执按规则失效；
execution_cases.summary_en: Invalidate old authorization according to policy-version rules.
execution_cases.summary_zh: 策略版本变化后旧回执按规则失效；

execution_cases.source_title: 回执过期后执行器拒绝执行；
execution_cases.summary_en: Refuse executor use after receipt expiry.
execution_cases.summary_zh: 回执过期后执行器拒绝执行；

execution_cases.source_title: 一次性回执不能被并发消费两次；
execution_cases.summary_en: Allow only one concurrent consumption of a single-use receipt.
execution_cases.summary_zh: 一次性回执不能被并发消费两次；

execution_cases.source_title: 恢复时会重新检查业务前置条件；
execution_cases.summary_en: Recheck business preconditions on resume.
execution_cases.summary_zh: 恢复时会重新检查业务前置条件；

execution_cases.source_title: 部分成功能够生成可核对的实际效果记录；
execution_cases.summary_en: Produce reconcilable per-object effects for partial success.
execution_cases.summary_zh: 部分成功能够生成可核对的实际效果记录；

execution_cases.source_title: 探针补全包可被采纳、部分采纳或拒绝，并保留记录。
execution_cases.summary_en: Record accepted, partially accepted and rejected supplements.
execution_cases.summary_zh: 探针补全包可被采纳、部分采纳或拒绝，并保留记录。

execution_cases.source_title: 发起者不能绕过职责分离；
execution_cases.summary_en: Prevent proposer bypass of separation of duties.
execution_cases.summary_zh: 发起者不能绕过职责分离；

execution_cases.source_title: 审批者不能批准超出角色权限的范围；
execution_cases.summary_en: Prevent approvers from authorizing beyond their role scope.
execution_cases.summary_zh: 审批者不能批准超出角色权限的范围；

execution_cases.source_title: 执行器不接受未签名、已撤销或来源不可信的回执；
execution_cases.summary_en: Reject unsigned, revoked or untrusted receipts.
execution_cases.summary_zh: 执行器不接受未签名、已撤销或来源不可信的回执；

execution_cases.source_title: 工具版本、环境和对象范围与批准不一致时拒绝执行；
execution_cases.summary_en: Refuse mismatched tool/version, environment or target scope.
execution_cases.summary_zh: 工具版本、环境和对象范围与批准不一致时拒绝执行；

execution_cases.source_title: 规则变更不能由受益代理单独批准；
execution_cases.summary_en: Prevent beneficiary-only approval of rule changes.
execution_cases.summary_zh: 规则变更不能由受益代理单独批准；

execution_cases.source_title: 所有高风险执行均可追溯到有效回执。
execution_cases.summary_en: Trace every high-risk execution to a valid receipt.
execution_cases.summary_zh: 所有高风险执行均可追溯到有效回执。

execution_cases.source_title: 服务重启后能够恢复等待状态；
execution_cases.summary_en: Restore durable waiting state after service restart.
execution_cases.summary_zh: 服务重启后能够恢复等待状态；

execution_cases.source_title: 重复审批回调不会重复计数；
execution_cases.summary_en: Duplicate approval callbacks do not double count.
execution_cases.summary_zh: 重复审批回调不会重复计数；

execution_cases.source_title: 重复恢复请求不会重复执行；
execution_cases.summary_en: Duplicate resume requests do not duplicate execution.
execution_cases.summary_zh: 重复恢复请求不会重复执行；

execution_cases.source_title: 外部调用超时后能先查状态再决定重试；
execution_cases.summary_en: Query external state after a timeout before deciding to retry.
execution_cases.summary_zh: 外部调用超时后能先查状态再决定重试；

execution_cases.source_title: 检查点损坏时系统选择停止，而不是猜测继续。
execution_cases.summary_en: Stop on corrupt checkpoints instead of guessing continuation.
execution_cases.summary_zh: 检查点损坏时系统选择停止，而不是猜测继续。

execution_cases.source_title: 每个关键阶段均有事件；
execution_cases.summary_en: Emit events at every critical stage.
execution_cases.summary_zh: 每个关键阶段均有事件；

execution_cases.source_title: 事件可通过 `trace_id`、`run_id` 和对象标识关联；
execution_cases.summary_en: Correlate events with trace/run and object identities.
execution_cases.summary_zh: 事件可通过 `trace_id`、`run_id` 和对象标识关联；

execution_cases.source_title: 提案、策略、回执和实际效果摘要可比对；
execution_cases.summary_en: Compare proposal, policy, receipt and actual-effect digests.
execution_cases.summary_zh: 提案、策略、回执和实际效果摘要可比对；

execution_cases.source_title: 审批等待时间、失效率、漂移率和绕过尝试可计算；
execution_cases.summary_en: Derive waiting, invalidation, drift and bypass-attempt measures from evidence.
execution_cases.summary_zh: 审批等待时间、失效率、漂移率和绕过尝试可计算；

execution_cases.source_title: 数据缺口可由探针形成补全包；

execution_cases.summary_zh: 数据缺口可由探针形成补全包；

execution_cases.source_title: 补全包不覆盖原始记录。

execution_cases.summary_zh: 补全包不覆盖原始记录。

probe_cases.source_title: 能从历史事件重建一条完整审批链路；

probe_cases.summary_zh: 能从历史事件重建一条完整审批链路；

probe_cases.source_title: 能识别缺失事件和孤立对象；

probe_cases.summary_zh: 能识别缺失事件和孤立对象；

probe_cases.source_title: 能计算主要路由、等待、漂移和执行指标；

probe_cases.summary_zh: 能计算主要路由、等待、漂移和执行指标；

probe_cases.source_title: 能发现提案摘要与回执摘要不一致；

probe_cases.summary_zh: 能发现提案摘要与回执摘要不一致；

probe_cases.source_title: 能发现无有效回执执行；

probe_cases.summary_zh: 能发现无有效回执执行；

probe_cases.source_title: 能输出数据质量等级；

probe_cases.summary_zh: 能输出数据质量等级；

probe_cases.source_title: 能生成补全包但不修改源记录。

probe_cases.summary_zh: 能生成补全包但不修改源记录。

probe_cases.source_title: 能接收执行流程的补全请求；
probe_cases.summary_en: Accept bounded supplement requests from execution.
probe_cases.summary_zh: 能接收执行流程的补全请求；

probe_cases.source_title: 能按允许来源查询数据；
probe_cases.summary_en: Query only allowed sources.
probe_cases.summary_zh: 能按允许来源查询数据；

probe_cases.source_title: 能返回来源、时效、置信度和冲突；

probe_cases.summary_zh: 能返回来源、时效、置信度和冲突；

probe_cases.source_title: 执行流程能返回采纳结果；

probe_cases.summary_zh: 执行流程能返回采纳结果；

probe_cases.source_title: 语义变化会触发新提案，而不是静默覆盖；

probe_cases.summary_zh: 语义变化会触发新提案，而不是静默覆盖；

probe_cases.source_title: 探针故障不会扩大执行权限；

probe_cases.summary_zh: 探针故障不会扩大执行权限；

probe_cases.summary_zh: 控制建议不会被误当作批准决定。

probe_cases.source_title: 指标公式有明确分子和分母；

probe_cases.summary_zh: 指标公式有明确分子和分母；

probe_cases.source_title: 时间窗口和策略版本可追溯；
probe_cases.summary_en: Trace window and policy version.
probe_cases.summary_zh: 时间窗口和策略版本可追溯；

probe_cases.source_title: 重复事件不造成重复计数；
probe_cases.summary_en: Duplicate events do not double count.
probe_cases.summary_zh: 重复事件不造成重复计数；

probe_cases.source_title: 延迟事件可以回补；
probe_cases.summary_en: Allow late events to revise versioned windows.
probe_cases.summary_zh: 延迟事件可以回补；

probe_cases.source_title: 不完整窗口被标记；
probe_cases.summary_en: Label incomplete windows.
probe_cases.summary_zh: 不完整窗口被标记；

probe_cases.source_title: 补全数据占比可见；
probe_cases.summary_en: Expose the proportion of supplemented data.
probe_cases.summary_zh: 补全数据占比可见；

probe_cases.source_title: 样本不足时不输出过度结论。
probe_cases.summary_en: Avoid definitive conclusions from insufficient samples.
probe_cases.summary_zh: 样本不足时不输出过度结论。

probe_cases.source_title: 探针服务账户无审批权；
probe_cases.summary_en: Probe service identity has no approval authority.
probe_cases.summary_zh: 探针服务账户无审批权；

probe_cases.source_title: 探针无高风险执行工具权限；
probe_cases.summary_en: Probe has no high-risk execution-tool authority.
probe_cases.summary_zh: 探针无高风险执行工具权限；

probe_cases.source_title: 敏感数据最小化；
probe_cases.summary_en: Minimize sensitive information.
probe_cases.summary_zh: 敏感数据最小化；

probe_cases.source_title: 补全查询范围受限；
probe_cases.summary_en: Restrict supplementary query scope.
probe_cases.summary_zh: 补全查询范围受限；

probe_cases.source_title: 原始记录不可覆盖；
probe_cases.summary_en: Original records remain immutable.
probe_cases.summary_zh: 原始记录不可覆盖；

probe_cases.source_title: 补全包可验证且可撤回；
probe_cases.summary_en: Supplements are verifiable and can be withdrawn through an audit record.
probe_cases.summary_zh: 补全包可验证且可撤回；

probe_cases.source_title: 探针规则变更有版本和审计。
probe_cases.summary_en: Probe rule changes have versions and audit history.
probe_cases.summary_zh: 探针规则变更有版本和审计。

objects.summary_en: Action proposal: canonical action and its evidence/scope bindings.
Evidence bundle: source, version, subject, digest, freshness and verification.
Policy snapshot: effective rules, route, approvers, separation, validity and rechecks.
Approval request: exact proposal/policy binding, card, assignment, expiry and resume node.
Individual decision: authenticated role, conditions, request binding and signature.
Governance receipt: limited signed permission; usage is verified against the transactional ledger.
Run checkpoint: durable bindings, decisions, missing roles, expiry and state version.
Actual effect: execution/receipt/business key, requested/actual digests and destination reference.
Supplement package: sourced facts about a bound target, never new authority.
Probe run: versioned probe set, mode, scope and lifecycle.
Trace view: linked runs, proposal/approval/receipt/execution/effect inventories and quality.
Data gap: entity field, classification, severity, source leads and recommended handling.
Supplement request: named gaps/fields, allowed sources, freshness/confidence and deadline.
Supplement package: same vocabulary as execution; target examples do not change permissions.
Adoption receipt: per-field accept/reject results, reason, target and processor/time.
Finding: evidence-backed rule/severity/status, observation times and recommendation.
Metric point: value/unit/dimensions/window/quality, augmented by population and missingness metadata.
